$comment: D-040: sites whose terms forbid automated collection, or that are behind logins. The collector never fetches a URL on these, whatever lane or link led to it. 'domains' match the domain and every subdomain. 'anyTld' matches the name as the site's own label under any suffix (eventbrite.com, eventbrite.co.uk, eventbrite.events). 'apiAllow' lists the official API endpoints that are the only permitted way in, by host and path prefix. Add entries here, never in code; removing one needs a decision in docs/DECISIONS.md.
